description: Source code for managing LoRaWAN non-volatile memory (NVM) settings, including saving, loading, and restoring LoRaWAN configuration data using Zephyr settings subsystem.

methods.name: lorawan_nvm_save_settings
methods.description: Saves specified LoRaWAN settings to non-volatile memory based on notification flags.

methods.name: load_setting
methods.description: Loads a setting from storage into target memory, verifying size and using a callback.

methods.name: on_setting_loaded
methods.description: Callback invoked when a setting is loaded, matches setting name and loads data into NVM structure.

methods.name: lorawan_nvm_data_restore
methods.description: Restores LoRaWAN configuration data from non-volatile storage into runtime context.

methods.name: lorawan_nvm_data_mgmt_event
methods.description: Handles NVM management events, triggers saving settings if flags are set.
